name: CPE Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，CPE Technology Berhad 通过其全资子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购物业和机器以扩大精密加工产能，并与 Kanekita Co., Ltd. 成立合资公司，进入钝化处理（passivation treatment）新业务，主要面向半导体行业。同时，公司完成对休眠子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 的自愿清盘。
overview_en: In 2026, CPE Technology Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd., acquired properties and machinery to expand precision machining capacity, and established a joint venture with Kanekita Co., Ltd. to enter the new passivation treatment business targeting mainly the semiconductor industry. Meanwhile, the company completed the member's voluntary winding-up of dormant subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 精密加工零件与组件
segments.note: 今年通过收购物业和机器扩大产能，并成立合资公司进入钝化处理新业务。
segments.note_en: This year, capacity was expanded through property and machinery acquisitions, and a joint venture was established to enter the new passivation treatment business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM14,500,000 收购物业。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired a property for RM14,500,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM10,000,000 收购物业。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired a property for RM10,000,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购机器。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired machineries.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购机器。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired machineries.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 补充公告：合资公司预计在协议日期后60天内注册成立，表面处理生产线预计在成立后12个月内完成安装和测试。
actions.text_en: Supplementary announcement: the JV company is expected to be incorporated within 60 days from the agreement date, and the surface treatment production line is expected to be installed and tested within 12 months from incorporation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Kanekita Co., Ltd. 签订合资协议，成立合资公司以制造和销售采用钝化处理技术的材料/产品，主要面向半导体行业。
actions.text_en: Entered into a share purchase and joint venture agreement with Kanekita Co., Ltd.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成休眠子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 的自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: This year, the member's voluntary winding-up of dormant subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. was completed.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年7月7日举行最终会议结束自愿清盘，清盘人最终会议报告已于2026年8月10日提交，预计三个月后完全解散。
actions.text_en: Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. held its final meeting on 7 July 2026 to conclude its member's voluntary winding-up; the Return by Liquidator was lodged on 10 August 2026, and the company will be fully dissolved after three months.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 启动成员自愿清盘，该公司自2019年11月1日起休眠。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. commenced member's voluntary winding-up; the company has been dormant since 1 November 2019.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过与 Kanekita Co., Ltd. 成立合资公司，新增采用钝化处理技术制造和销售材料/产品的业务线，主要面向半导体行业。
model_changes.text_en: Through the establishment of a joint venture with Kanekita Co., Ltd., a new business line of manufacturing and selling materials/products utilizing passivation treatment technology was added, primarily targeting the semiconductor industry.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 全资子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 启动自愿清盘，退出该休眠子公司的业务。
model_changes.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. commenced voluntary winding-up, exiting the business of this dormant subsidiary.
